text:
When alpha particles are incident on a thin metal foil, most of them pass through undeviated.
What does this observation reveal about the nature of the atom?
A
The atom has a dense nucleus.
B
The atom is mostly empty space.
C
The atom is very small.
D
The nucleus of the atom is positively charged.

options.label: A
options.text: The atom has a dense nucleus.

options.label: B
options.text: The atom is mostly empty space.

options.label: D
options.text: The nucleus of the atom is positively charged.
